title: В + accusative: At five, once a week, that day, the first time

blocks.text: В + Accusative is used to indicate the time of the day, the day of the week, and how frequently something occurs.

«В + Accusative is used: (a) to indicate the time of the day; (b) to indicate the day of the week; (c) to indicate how frequently something occurs.» «Note also the following expressions: В минуту опасности. В годы войны. Во время войны. В первый раз. В следующий раз. В последний раз.» «Units smaller than a week (day, hour etc.) take „В + Acc.“»

DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 19 and 73. One sentence at a time, in a new order each time you open this chapter; it is finished when every one has been answered right. The sentences are real: the source of each is shown with it.
